results.title: Write and run a bash script

steps_log.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/ageval && cat > /tmp/ageval/disk-check.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Get disk usage percentage of the root filesystem (/)
# Use 'df -h /' and awk to extract the percentage value (e.g., 85%)
USAGE_PERCENT=$(df / | awk 'NR==2 {print $5}' | sed 's/%//')

# Check the usage
if [ "$USAGE_PERCENT" -lt 90 ]; then
    echo "OK" > /tmp/ageval/disk-status.txt
else
    echo "WARNING" > /tmp/ageval/disk-status.txt
fi
EOF
